projects.name: ROW Optimization workflow exception management, portfolio and wealth management
details: platforms, and risk and compliance regulatory projects (State Street/Munich_Re/PIMCO/Blackrock/Lazard)
• Led the delivery of the MVP ROW Dashboard for DAG and Reconciliation, achieving a 20% reduction in reconciliation
turnaround time and significantly improving reporting accuracy and operational visibility.
• Defined UAT strategy and designed comprehensive UAT test scripts across Money Market, FX, Fixed Income, Structured
Products, Derivatives, and Collateral Management, resulting in a 15% reduction in post-deployment defects.
• Oversaw SIT/UAT validation, coordinated re-testing of failed scenarios, and managed regression testing, ensuring release
readiness and minimizing critical issues prior to production deployment.
• Ensured adherence to capital markets regulatory requirements by strengthening data governance, reporting accuracy, and
control effectiveness across systems and processes.
• Acted as a functional consultant providing end-to-end support to Front Office, Middle Office, and Operations teams.
• Managed pre-go-live activities including Production Verification (PLV) testing and ensured readiness for system deployment.
• Provided post-go-live support, troubleshooting system issues, and ensuring minimal disruption to business operations.
• Coordinated and led UAT cycles with IT teams and third-party vendors, ensuring timely delivery and issue resolution.
• Demonstrated deep understanding of Treasury processes and Summit system integrations across front-to-back office
workflows.
• Collaborated effectively with business and technical stakeholders, translating requirements into functional solutions.
• Worked in Agile environments, adapting to evolving priorities and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives.
• Applied strong problem-solving and analytical skills to assess technical architecture and drive system enhancements.
• Delivered both in-house and vendor-based IT solutions aligned with business needs and regulatory requirements.
• Promoted a collaborative team environment with strong interpersonal and communication skills.
• Played a key role in regulatory remediation initiatives by identifying control gaps, defining corrective action plans, and
tracking closure to successful audit and compliance outcomes.
• Managed project scope, budget, and schedule across multiple initiatives, ensuring alignment with business objectives and
timely delivery.
• Led Project Working Group (PWG) and Steering Committee meetings, presenting project updates, risks, and key decisions to senior stakeholders.
• Prepared and maintained portfolio-level reporting, including project status, budget tracking, scope management, and delivery
timelines.
• Produced weekly project status reports, highlighting milestones, progress, and potential delivery risks.
• Managed RAID logs (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) to proactively identify, track, and mitigate project risks.
• Facilitated Agile Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
• Collaborated closely with Product Owners to manage the product backlog, prioritize features, and support continuous feature
delivery

workflows.
• Managed end-to-end business analysis across custodian, middle-office, and back-office operations, supporting daily FX,
Equity, and Fixed Income trade reconciliation and settlement workflows.
• Collaborated closely with traders, operations, risk, and technology teams to design and deliver solutions that improved
operational throughput and reduced reconciliation errors by 20%.
• Led requirements elicitation, analysis, and prioritization through workshops, interviews, and walkthroughs, enabling
delivery of scalable and regulatory-compliant applications.

• Coordinated with onshore stakeholders and clients for requirement validation, UAT support, knowledge transfer, and end- user training, achieving 95% satisfaction scores in post-implementation surveys.
• Identified opportunities for process automation and operational efficiency, reducing manual interventions and enhancing
system reliability.
• Provided actionable insights and recommendations to improve workflows across trade settlement, corporate actions, and risk
monitoring.
• Certified Business Analyst Professional™ CBAP (International Institute of Business Analysis –IIBA)
• Certified SAFe® Product Owner & Product Manager (Scaled Agile, Inc.)
• Diploma in Digital Transformation and Operational Excellence MTF Institute
• Diploma in Retail Banking and Wealth Management
• Process Mapping with BPMN 2.0 (GBTEC Group)
• AI Tools Workshop (Be10x)
ICFAI U n i v e r s i t y M BA  ( Finance) 2007 Pune MH
North Maharashtra University Bachelor of commence (Banking & Accountancy)  2004  Jalgaon MH
ROW DAG & Reconciliation Project (Exception Management)-Implemented Read-Optimized Write Directed Acyclic Graph
(ROW DAG) optimization and a reconciliation framework, which reduced exception rates by 30% and increased operational
transparency across reporting teams.
Application Migration Project (TLM vs TLP Reconciliation) Led the migration of over critical business applications from
legacy TLM to TLP reconciliation platforms, managing a large-scale, high complexity project that resulted in a 30% reduction
in processing errors and significantly improved audit compliance. Coordinated cross-functional teams and designed
automated data validation scripts to ensure a seamless transition, maintaining 100% data integrity and uninterrupted process
continuity throughout the migration.
Fail Station Setup – Led the design and implementation of a robust failover DAG setup across multiple asset classes by
coordinating cross-functional teams and developing automated failover scripts, which reduced system downtime by 40% and
ensured uninterrupted business operations during outages.
Portfolio Management System Implementation – Led the implementation and integration of Portfolio Management and
Investment platforms including Charles River Investment Management Solution, BlackRock Aladdin, PIMS, Depository Trust
& Clearing Corporation, CTM, and Eagle Investment Systems to support trading, reconciliation, portfolio accounting, and
post-trade operations across asset classes.
Forward FX Netting : (Integrated with CRTS) : Led and contributed to the implementation of a Forward FX Netting solution
aimed at optimizing settlement processes and reducing counterparty exposure. The project involved gathering business

requirements from Treasury stakeholders, designing netting logic for FX forward deals, and developing UAT scenarios to validate end-to-end workflows. Coordinated closely with IT teams and vendors to ensure accurate system configuration within
the Summit platform. Successfully executed UAT, identified and resolved defects, and ensured smooth deployment. The
solution improved operational efficiency, reduced settlement volumes, and enhanced risk management through effective
netting mechanisms.
Investment & Capital Markets Platforms:
Bloomberg, TLM, Charles River, Aladdin, PIMS, DTCC, CTM, Fail station, Eagle Investment Systems, Portfolio
Management Systems, Trade Lifecycle Management, Reconciliation Platforms, Regulatory Reporting, Custody Operations,
Wealth Management Platforms.
